findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: div.icon elements contain raw emoji text '⚡', '🔒', '📈', the eyebrow reads '🚀 POWERED BY AI', the logo text is 'Lumina ✨'. With no aria-hidden, screen readers announce 'high voltage', 'locked', 'chart increasing', 'rocket', 'sparkles' before each heading.
findings.after:
⚡
; ✨ in the logo
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content: decorative glyphs must be hidden from assistive tech.

findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: all 11 links have href="#" ('Product', 'Pricing', 'Docs', 'Sign in', 'Watch demo', 'Join the waitlist →'...). Each announces as a link but goes nowhere; 'Watch demo' implies a video that does not exist.
findings.after: Real destinations, or <button> for in-page actions; remove links with no target
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose and 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value: the role promises navigation that never happens.

findings.evidence: Confirms sweep ROB-003: at 375 the nav does not collapse; all five links, 'Sign in' and a circular 'Get started' blob sit in one row, pushing the page to 694px so the hero renders in the left half with an empty dark right half.
findings.after: @media (max-width: 720px) { .nav-links { display:none } } plus a disclosure button with aria-expanded
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.10 Reflow: content must fit 320 CSS px without two-direction scrolling.

findings.where: hero h1 gradient text and primary buttons
findings.evidence: Confirms sweep A11-001: 'Get started →' is white at 0.6 opacity over pink #c750bd (2.36:1); the h1 gradient ends in #ec4899 pink on #0a0a14, and 'Join the waitlist →' white on the pink end of its gradient is 3.85:1 at 15px.
findings.after: Solid #fff text on a solid #6d28d9 fill (7:1+), no opacity on button text
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum), measured on the worst gradient stop.

findings.evidence: Sections are bare <section> elements under body; no <main> (sweep), no skip link; first focusable is 'Product'. The 'Lumina ✨' logo is a div, not a home link.
findings.after: <main id="main"> around the sections and a skip link to it
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships and 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks.

strengths: One h1, headings in order (h1 > h2 > h3 > h2); html lang set; visible focus outline on all 10 stops.
not_investigated: the page's own antipattern-detector script was blocked by capture prep; it is not part of the design
keyboard: no menus, dialogs or custom controls to test
